name: ask_setup_source
title: Ask for another of the owner's projects as an idea source
description: Asks the owner whose open request you work on which of their other projects (same e-mail) you may look at for setup ideas, or none. Once per setup. None owned: setup_source_none. Their own answer lets read_setup_source read that project for a day.
